What if the Ramayana and Mahabharata were also read as texts of political thought?

In this session, Chandan Sir looks at these epics through the lens of Political Science and asks some interesting questions: What do Shri Rama, Sugriva, Shri Hanuman and Angad tell us about alliances, diplomacy, power and negotiation? What does Rama’s conflict between raj dharma and personal duty tell us about kingship?

From political strategy to peace efforts and the idea of an ideal ruler, this session explores the political ideas hidden in familiar stories.

snippet.description:
Why did LevelUp IAS launch a new mentorship program for UPSC 2027?

With LMP 2027 already in place, why was there a need for another mentorship program?

In this video, LevelUp IAS explains the thinking behind LMP Ascend 2027. Some aspirants missed the LMP admission window and continued requesting a full-fledged mentorship programme. However, launching another programme with exactly the same timeline was not practical.

That led to LMP Ascend — a modified mentorship plan designed around a slightly different Mains-to-Prelims preparation timeline.

Under this structure, the focus remains on completing the major Mains subjects by around mid-January, while certain topics that are more Current Affairs-centric, such as International Relations and Essay, are scheduled for after Prelims. From around mid-January, the preparation gradually shifts towards UPSC Prelims 2027.

The objective is to bring LMP Ascend students close to the LMP preparation timeline by the end of December while maintaining a structured roadmap for Mains, Prelims, revision, testing and mentorship.

Explore LMP Ascend 2027 by LevelUp IAS:
https://www.levelupias.com/courses/upsc-cse-ascend-levelup-mentorship-program-lmp-ascend/

#LMPAscend #upsc2027  #upscmentorship  #upscpreparation2027  #upscstrategy  #upscmains  #upscprelims  #UPSCMentorshipProgram #levelupias  #upscpreparation
